title: How to Create Text Driven Video with Codex MCP and Medux
description: Learn how to use Codex MCP and Medux to generate an avatar video from text using a reusable avatar and voice, including setup, request fields, tool…
operation: Generate an avatar video from text using a reusable avatar and voice.
prompt: Create a 7 second 1080P 16:9 talking video from this script using avatar asset id {avatar asset id}, voice asset id {voice asset id}, and model id talking-video-text-standard.

fields.name: aspect_ratio
fields.purpose: Requested output aspect ratio, such as 16:9 or 9:16.

fields.name: avatar_asset_id
fields.purpose: Reusable avatar asset ID owned by the current user or listed as an official public asset.

fields.name: clarity
fields.purpose: Requested output resolution label, such as 1080P or 2K.

fields.name: links
fields.purpose: Optional reference links submitted from the Playground form.

fields.name: model
fields.purpose: Generation model label or version selected in the Playground form.

fields.name: text
fields.purpose: Provide the value described in the API reference.

fields.name: title
fields.purpose: Provide the value described in the API reference.

fields.name: voice_asset_id
fields.purpose: Reusable voice asset used for text-driven lip sync.
